feature: Native X11 keyboard word selection, extension, cancellation and persistence
checks: Keyboard opens the numbered source-word list
Cancel after selecting the second word leaves saved excerpts and reading pixels unchanged
Keyboard extends the second word to the third and previews the font without saving early
Save records chapter 0, block 4, bytes 264 through 272 as the font
Quit/reopen preserves all three exact clipping records, reading position and bookmark
Reading pixels remain byte-identical after cancellation, save and reopen
Complete native reader, catalog, sync fault and tailnet lifecycle suite passes
visual_findings: Original-resolution screenshots show numbered words in the list with the first row selected and page 1 of 19
The preview shows Cancel, Save selection, Extend selection and the font
limits: This covers a portrait Latin phrase on X11; native RTL, rotation, long-list traversal and Wayland are not qualified by this fixture.
Physical Picco button input, dense-page memory and latency remain unqualified.
No production code changed and no firmware rebuild was needed for this fixture change.
